diagnosis.evidence: The isolated test reproduces against a new GUID-named database. Production and current PostgreSQL fixtures configure __EFMigrationsHistory in schema public, while this historical test constructs UseNpgsql without that mapping. The second context then attempts to replay InitialVulgataDomain and collides with vulgata.GlobalContexts.
falsified: database name collision or retained database contamination

raw_result.summary: Final verification exposed a deterministic historical test-fixture defect after infrastructure resolution. The isolated PostgreSQL migration lifecycle test fails because its context omits the repository-standard public migration-history mapping; this is not a Story 18.1 production behavior failure.
